1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Roman
Catholic Bishops (Incorporation) Ordinance, 1957.

2. (1) The Right Reverend Monseigneur Michael
Olcomendy the Titular Roman Catholic Archbishop of
Singapore Malacca and his successors in office shall
be a body corporate (hereinafter called "the Singapore
Malacca Corporation") and shall for the purpose of
this Ordinance have the name of "The Titular Roman
Catholic Archbishop of Singapore Malacca" and by
that name have perpetual succession and shall have and
may use a corporate seal which may from time to time

(2) The Singapore Malacca Corporation may
acquire, purchase, take, hold and enjoy all movable
and immovable property of every description and may
sell, convey, assign, surrender and yield up, mortgage,
demise, re-assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of any
movable or immovable property vested in it upon such
terms as to such Corporation seems fit and may sue
and be sued in respect of such property in any Court.

3. (1) The Right Reverend Monseigneur Dominic
Aloysius Vendargon the Titular Roman Catholic
Bishop of Kuala Lumpur and his successors in office
shall be a body corporate (hereinafter called "the Kuala
Lumpur Corporation") and shall for the purpose of
this Ordinance have the name of "The Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur" and by that name
have perpetual succession and shall have and may use
a corporate seal which may from time to time be
broken, changed, altered and made anew as to the
Kuala Lumpur Corporation seems fit.

(2) The Kuala Lumpur Corporation may acquire,
purchase, take, hold and enjoy movable and immovable
property of every description and may sell, convey,
assign, surrender and yield up, mortgage, demise, re-
assign, transfer or otherwise dispose of any movable
or immovable property vested in it upon such terms
as to such Corporation seems fit and may sue and be
sued in respect of such property in any Court.

4, (1) The Right Reverend Monseigneur Francis
Chan the Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Penang
and his successors in office shall be a body corporate
(hereinafter called "the Penang Corporation") and shall
for the purpose of this Ordinance have the name of
"The Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Penang" and
by that name have perpetual succession and shall have
and may use a corporate seal which may from time to
time be broken, changed, altered and made anew as to
the Penang Corporation seems fit.

(2) The Penang Corporation may acquire, purchase,
take, hold and enjoy movable and immovable property
of every description and may sell, convey, assign,
surrender and yield up, mortgage, demise, re-assign,
transfer or otherwise dispose of any movable or
immovable property vested in it upon such terms as to

ROMAN CATHOLIC BISHOPS (INCORPORATION) 285

such Corporation seems fit and may sue and be sued
in respect of such property in any Court.

5. (1) The expression "successors in office" shall be
deemed to include either an Administrator Apostolic
or a Vicar Capitular of the Dioceses of Singapore
Malacca, Kuala Lumpur and Penang from the time
when the office of the Titular Roman Catholic Arch-
bishop of Singapore Malacca, the office of the Roman
Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur or the office of the
Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Penang becomes
vacant by the resignation, absence or death of the
holder of such office for the time being until the formal
assumption of office by his successor.

(2) There shall not be in any one Diocese concurrent
holders of any two of the offices of Archbishop or
Bishop as the case may be and Administrator Apostolic
or Vicar Capitular; and any power of attorney given
by any one of them shall cease to be valid when the
donor of the power of attorney ceases to administer the
affairs of the Diocese concerned.

6. (1) All immovable property situate in the State
of Johore and the Settlement of Malacca heretofore
conveyed or assigned to or vested in the Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Malacca whether with or without
the name of the ecclesiastic for the time being formerly
holding such office and whether with or without the
addition of the words "resident in the Straits Settle-
ments" is hereby vested in the Singapore Malacca
Corporation for the respective estates and interests for
which the same is holden.

_ (2) All immovable property situate in the States of
Selangor, Negri Sembilan, Pahang and Trengganu
heretofore conveyed or assigned to or vested in the
Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Malacca whether
with or without the name of the ecclesiastic for the
time being formerly holding such office and whether
with or without the addition of the words "resident in
the Straits Settlements" is hereby vested in the Kuala
Lumpur Corporation for the respective estates and
interests for which the same is holden.

(3) All immovable property in the Settlement of
Penang and the States of Kedah, Perak, Perlis and
Kelantan heretofore conveyed or assigned to or vested
in the Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Malacca
whether with or without the name of the ecclesiastic
for the time being formerly holding such office and

7. (1) All deeds, documents and other instruments
requiring the seal of the Singapore Malacca Corporation
shall be sealed with the seal of the Singapore Malacca
Corporation in the presence of the Titular Roman
Catholic Archbishop of Singapore Malacca for the time
being or when the Archbishopric is vacant in the
presence of the Administrator Apostolic or of the Vicar
Capitular of the Diocese of Singapore Malacca, as the
case may be, or by the attorney of any one of them
duly authorised by a power of attorney a true copy
or an office copy of which has been deposited pursuant
to the provisions of section 4 of the Powers of Attorney
Ordinance, 1949, and shall also be signed by the said
Archbishop for the time being or by the said Adminis-
trator Apostolic or Vicar Capitular as the case may be
or the attorney of any one of them so authorised as
aforesaid.

(2) All deeds, documents and other instruments
requiring the seal of the Kuala Lumpur Corporation
shall be sealed with the seal of the Kuala Lumpur
Corporation in the presence of the Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur for the time being
or when the Bishopric is vacant in the presence of the
Administrator Apostolic or Vicar Capitular of the
Diocese of Kuala Lumpur as the case may be or the
attorney of any one of them duly authorised by a power
of attorney a true copy or an office copy of which has
been deposited pursuant to the provisions of section 4
of the Powers of Attorney Ordinance, 1949, and shall
be signed by the said Bishop or by the Administrator
Apostolic or Vicar Capitular as the case may be or the |
attorney of any one of them as aforesaid.

(3) All deeds, documents and other instruments
requiring the seal of the Penang Corporation shall be
sealed with the seal of the Penang Corporation in the
presence of the Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of
Penang for the time being or when the Bishopric is
vacant in the presence of the Administrator Apostolic
or Vicar Capitular of the Diocese of Penang as the
case may be or the attorney of any one of them duly
authorised by a power of attorney a true copy or an
office copy of which has been deposited pursuant to

ROMAN CATHOLIC BISHOPS (INCORPORATION)   287

the provisions of section 4 of the Powers of Attorney no. 64 of
Ordinance, 1949, and shall also be signed by the said 194%.
Bishop or by the Administrator Apostolic or Vicar
Capitular as the case may be or the attorney or any

one of them as aforesaid.

(4) Such signing shall be and be taken as sufficient
evidence that the said seal was duly and properly
affixed and that the same is the lawful seal of the
Singapore Malacca Corporation, the Kuala Lumpur
Corporation, or the Penang Corporation, as the case
may be.

8. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment Notification.
of any person to exercise the office of the Roman
Catholic Archbishop of Singapore Malacca, the Roman
Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur or the Roman
Catholic Bishop of Penang or of Administrator
Apostolic or Vicar Capitular of the Diocese of
Singapore Malacca, or of the Diocese of Kuala Lumpur,
or of the Diocese of Penang, as the case may be, shall
be conclusive evidence that such person was duly
authorised to exercise the said office in the State of
Johore and the Settlement of Malacca, or the States of
Selangor, Negri Sembilan, Pahang and Trengganu or
the Settlement of Penang and the States of Kedah,
Perak, Perlis and Kelantan, as the case may be.

9. (1) The Singapore Malacca Corporation shall have Offices
an office in the Federation the address of which shall 3 R° ion.
be the Church of Saint Francis Xavier, Malacca.

(2) The Kuala Lumpur Corporation shall have an
office in the Federation the address of which shall be
the Saint John's Cathedral, Kuala Lumpur.

(3) The Penang Corporation shall have an office in
the Federation the address of which shall be the
Cathedral of the Assumption, Penang.

10. The Ordinance and Enactments specified in the Repeal.
Schedule hereto insofar as the same affect the Federa-
tion are hereby repealed.

11. Nothing in this Ordinance contained shall affect saving of
the rights or Her Majesty or of Their Highnesses the pubes
Rulers of the Malay States or of any body politic or
corporate or of any other person except such as are
mentioned in this Ordinance and those claiming by,
through or under them.

i

An Act to amend the Roman Catholic Bishop (Incor-
poration) Ordinance, 1957, to provide for the change of
the name of the Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Kuala
Lumpur and the incorporation of the Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Melaka Johor and to provide for
matters connected therewith.           |

[                ]

WHEREAS the Titular Roman Catholic) Archbishop of
Singapore Malacca, the Titular Roman /Catholic Bishop

of Kuala Lumpur and the Titular Roman Catholic Bishop

of Penang are incorporated by the Roman Catholic Bishops
(Incorporation) Ordinance, 1957 (hereinafter referred to as 38/57.
the Ordinance);                  Sa      j

AND WHEREAS by a Decree of the Holy See of Rome
published on the 18th day of December, 1972, the Diocese
of Kuala Lumpur was created an Archdiocese: and the
Titular Roman Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur was raised
to the dignity of Archbishop;     /               :

AND WHEREAS by the same Decree of the Holy See of
Rome made on the 18th day of December, 1972, the
Archdiocese of. Singapore Malacca was divided and the
territory consisting of the Republic of Singapore became
the Archdiocese of Singapore; and the territories consisting
of the States of Melaka and Johor became the Diocese of
Melaka Johor, arid the States of Selangor, Negri Sembilan,
Pahang and Trengganu became the Archdiocese of Kuala
Lumpur and the States of Penang, Kedah, Perak, Perlis and
Kelantan remained the Diocese of Penang;

BE IT ENACTED by the Duli Yang Maha Mulia Seri
Paduka Baginda Yang di-Pertuan Agong with the advice
and consent of the Dewan Negara and Dewan Rakyat in

Parliament assembled, and by authority of the same, as
follows;

1, This Act may be cited as the Roman Catholic Bishops
(Change of Name and Incorporation) Act, 1974.

2. (1) The Titular Roman Catholic. Bishop of Kuala
Lumpur, as incorporated under section 3 of the Ordinance
otherwise called "the Kuala Lumpur Corporation" for the
purpose of the Ordinance shall after the commencement of
this Act be known as the Titular Roman Catholic Arch-
bishop of Kuala Lumpur and shall continue to be called
for the purpose of the Ordinance "the Kuala Lumpur
Corporation".

(2) All immovable property that immediately before the
commencement of this Act were vested in the Titular
Roman Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur shall on that day
vest in the Titular Roman Catholic Archbishop of Kuala
Lumpur.

(3) The change of name provided by this section shall not
affect any rights or obligations of the Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Kuala Lumpur or render defective any
legal proceedings by or against it; and any legal proceedings
that could have been continued or commenced by or against
it prior to the commencement of this Act may be continued
or commenced under its new name.

3. The Ordinance is hereby amended by inserting imme-
diately after section 4 thereof, the following new section

and yield up, mortgage, demise, re-assign, transfer

as to such Corporation seems fit and may sue and

4, (1) The Titular Roman Catholic Archbishop of
Singapore Malacca as incorporated under section 2 of the
Ordinance otherwise called the Singapore Malacca Cor-
poration for the purpose of the Ordinance in whom is
vested all movable and immovable property situated in
Johor and Melaka belonging to the Singapore Malacca
Corporation immediately before the commencement of this
Act is hereby divested of all such movable and immovable
property and all estates rights and interests therein.

(2) All movable and immovable property referred to in
subsection (1) and all estates rights and interests therein are
hereby vested in the Melaka Johor Corporation for the
respective estates rights and interests for which the same
are held and the Melaka Johor Corporation shall have full
power to deal with the said property.

5. Section 5 of the Ordinance is hereby amended by
substituting for subsection (1), the following new subsection
(>

deemed to include either an Administrator Apostolic
or a Vicar Capitular of the Dioceses of Kuala Lumpur,
Penang and Melaka Johor from the time when the
office of the Titular Roman Catholic Archbishop of
Kuala Lumpur, the office of the Titular Roman Catholic
Bishop of Penang or the office of the Titular Roman
Catholic Bishop of Melaka Johor becomes vacant by
the resignation, absence or death of the holder of such
office for the time being until the formal assumption of
office by his successor.".
